tbesh_html:
1) to bring out, furnish, promote, go out, issue
1a) (Hiphil)
1a1) to produce, furnish
1a2) to bring out, elicit, obtain, cause to come out from
1a3) to promote
1a4) to cause to go out to

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (identical with H6328 (פּוּק) through the idea of dropping out; compare H5312 (נְפַק));
strongs_1890.kjv_def: afford, draw out, further, get, obtain.
